en: A vintage monochrome postcard showing a quiet, tree‑lined street with cobblestones and sidewalks. On the right side stand several large brick townhouses or villas with ornate façades, gabled roofs, chimneys, and fenced front gardens with metal gates. The left side of the street is bordered by trees and a long fence. The printed caption at the top in red German text reads: "Dommitzsch a. Elbe. Bahnhofstraße."
